title: Design, synthesis, and evaluation of anti-solid-tumor activity of niclosamide-based STAT3/HDAC dual-target inhibitors.
authors: Shi, Yuchen; Zhang, Qihao; Wang, Chenxi; Lu, Zipeng; Chen, Fangfang; Han, Liu; Xu, Zhouyang; Zhang, Yuan; Ma, Shumei; Ye, Faqing; Wang, Xuebao
one_liner_zh: 该文设计合成STAT3/HDAC双靶抑制剂，虽涉及STAT3蛋白与DNA结合域相关但核心是药物化学与抗肿瘤活性，仅用对接和MD模拟辅助验证结合模式，非聚焦TF-DNA互作机制建模，方法应用浅层。
abstract: Inspired by reports that HDAC blockade can trigger compensatory activation of the LIFR-JAK1-STAT3 axis in solid tumors, we designed and synthesized a series of niclosamide-based STAT3/HDAC dual-target inhibitor candidates by incorporating a SAHA-derived hydroxamate zinc-binding group into the pleiotropic, STAT3-modulating niclosamide scaffold. Biological evaluation identified NS06 as the best-balanced analogue, with IC(50) values of 1.49 and 1.41 muM against MDA-MB-231 and HCT116 cells, respectively. Mechanistic studies showed that NS06 bound STAT3 in vitro (SPR, K(D) = 5.82 muM), suppressed STAT3 phosphorylation, and inhibited HDAC1, HDAC3, and HDAC6 with IC(50) values of 129.1, 451.2, and 230.4 nM, respectively, while showing limited inhibition of HDAC4 and HDAC11 in the primary screen. NS06 also increased histone H3 acetylation, induced apoptosis, and inhibited migration and colony formation. In addition, NS06 retained antiproliferative activity in a 3D tumor spheroid model and showed improved Caco-2 permeability together with moderate liver microsomal stability (t(1/2)  approximately  48.6 min in rat liver microsomes). Docking and 100-ns molecular dynamics simulations further supported chemically plausible binding modes in the HDAC1 catalytic pocket and the STAT3 SH2 domain. Overall, these findings support niclosamide as a tractable scaffold for mechanism-driven STAT3/HDAC dual-target inhibitor design and identify NS06 as a promising lead for further optimization against solid tumors.
abstract_zh: 受HDAC阻断可触发实体瘤中LIFR-JAK1-STAT3轴代偿性激活的报道启发，我们通过将SAHA衍生的羟肟酸锌结合基团引入多效性、调节STAT3的氯硝柳胺骨架中，设计并合成了一系列基于氯硝柳胺的STAT3/HDAC双靶点抑制剂候选物。生物学评价确定NS06为平衡性最佳的类似物，其对MDA-MB-231和HCT116细胞的IC(50)值分别为1.49和1.41 μM。机制研究表明，NS06在体外结合STAT3（SPR，K(D) = 5.82 μM），抑制STAT3磷酸化，并以129.1、451.2和230.4 nM的IC(50)值分别抑制HDAC1、HDAC3和HDAC6，而在初步筛选中对HDAC4和HDAC11的抑制作用有限。NS06还增加组蛋白H3乙酰化，诱导凋亡，并抑制迁移和集落形成。此外，NS06在3D肿瘤球模型中保留了抗增殖活性，并显示出改善的Caco-2渗透性以及中等程度的肝微粒体稳定性（大鼠肝微粒体中t(1/2) ≈ 48.6分钟）。对接和100 ns分子动力学模拟进一步支持了HDAC1催化口袋和STAT3 SH2结构域中化学上合理的结合模式。总体而言，这些发现支持氯硝柳胺作为机制驱动的STAT3/HDAC双靶点抑制剂设计的可行骨架，并确定NS06为针对实体瘤进一步优化的有前景的先导化合物。
